transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, September 26. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Zuckerberg's $300m superyacht docks in Japan, gets neighbour who once wanted Meta out. Mark Zuckerberg's impressive superyacht, Launchpad, has recently anchored in Japan, right beside Yusaku Maezawa's Nausicaä. Their close proximity underscores an ongoing legal dispute as Maezawa pursues Meta for the misuse of his name in deceptive investment advertising. Even without plans to meet, their vessels symbolize the intense rivalry. After a summer in Alaska, Launchpad is set to chart its course towards Singapore, making this encounter noteworthy. Nebraska couple lost $59,759 home over $588 tax debt; compensation claim revived. A Nebraska couple, Kevin Fair and Terry Fair, lost their home due to unpaid property taxes totaling $588. After being unable to pay the amount required to redeem their property, Continental Resources obtained a tax deed. Fair claimed that losing property worth $59,759 for such a small tax debt constituted an unconstitutional taking. The Nebraska Supreme Court ruled Fair had a valid takings claim based on property value. Tom Brady versus Patrick Mahomes: Why TB12 Foundation can't match 15 and Mahomies. Tom Brady's TB12 Foundation was focused on health and wellness of underserved athletes and service members. Patrick Mahomes' 15 and the Mahomies is focused on children, communities in need of resources and other charitable causes. Mahomes' foundation is more popular than Brady's because he has a broader scope with youth initiatives. 'Choice now rests with US': Iran offers 7-day plan to reopen Hormuz - how it will work. Iran has offered the United States a seven-day plan to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz and resume stalled talks on its nuclear programme, with foreign minister Abbas Araghchi saying the next move now rests with Washington. How Zhu Jiner turned struggles in India into taking China closer to Chess Olympiad gold. China currently lead the women's Chess Olympiad in Samarkand despite missing its top three players. World No. 4 Zhu Jiner has emerged as the team's unbeaten Board 1, rebounding strongly from a difficult GCL campaign in Bengaluru. In an exclusive interaction with TimesofIndia.com, she reflects on India's chess passion, her journey into professional chess, and China's unexpected title challenge. Marking 'VIPs' routine, was part of SSR even before SIR: Officials. EC, which is reeling under allegations of faultlines among its members, is now being questioned over a software update recently made in the application used by booth level officers, with its description on the Apple app store reading "mark VIP elector-related changes". Why Trump's F-35 deal with Saudi Arabia unsettles Israel, opens big door for China. Under the deal, the state department has notified Congress of a possible sale of 48 jets, with engines and support, which would make Saudi Arabia the second country in the Middle East to fly the aircraft after Israel. The Saudi jets will reportedly not have all the advanced features of the F-35s operated by Israel. Trump, Xi end 3-day summit with tea, stability pledge and little progress on key disputes. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping wrapped up their three-day summit on Friday with tea at the White House and a tour of the National Archives, ending a high-profile visit marked by personal diplomacy and ceremony but few major public breakthroughs on trade, Taiwan, artificial intelligence or other contentious issues. Historic Penn's Cave for sale: $34M for 1,400-acre park after 118 years. Penn's Cave and Wildlife Park in Pennsylvania is seeking a new owner for the first time in 118 years. The Campbell family has listed the 1,400-acre property for $34 million. The historic attraction includes an all-water cavern, wildlife park, private airport and other attractions. The family says preserving the property's legacy and natural resources remains a priority. Watch: Russian drones hit McDonald's-linked warehouse in Ukraine, 5 killed. A warehouse used by the logistics partner of US fast-food chain McDonald's was hit in Russian drone attacks on Kyiv on Friday, with Ukrainian authorities saying five people were killed and 27 injured across the capital. Minnesota farm becomes 262 homes: 88-acre project approved till 2032. Heavy machinery has begun grading the former Vierling family farm in Minnesota for a new housing development. The Prior Lake City Council recently approved the plans for the 262-home neighborhood named Vierling Ridge. Pulte Homes aims to complete the main infrastructure by autumn, allowing construction to begin in winter. Various housing styles are planned, catering to different demographics and needs. Autonomy reference in Omar's statehood resolution sparks row; BJP tears up copies. Chief minister Omar Abdullah brought Friday an assembly resolution seeking restoration of full statehood for J and K, but an autonomy reference ignited a BJP backlash, with its members ripping up copies amid anti-national chants directed at the governing National Conference (NC).

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. MP Bus Service Returns After 21 Years; Gadkari Warns Against Compromise On Quality, Safety. Madhya Pradesh launched the Mukhyamantri Sugam Parivahan Seva and PM e-Bus Sewa in Bhopal on September 25, rolling out 351 buses across seven cities. Madhya Pradesh Seeks rupees 4,600 Crore From Centre To Upgrade Roads In 51 Towns Under OTI Scheme. Madhya Pradesh has sought rupees 4,600 crore under the Centre's one-time improvement scheme to upgrade roads in 51 towns, with cement-concrete construction proposed. MP AYUSH Colleges Face Triple-Salary Penalty If Faculty Vacancies Remain Unfilled Beyond 3 Months. AYUSH colleges have been directed to replace teaching faculty within three months of a vacancy or face a financial penalty. Madhya Pradesh High Court Orders Full Pay For 11 Probationer Forest Guards In Jabalpur. The Madhya Pradesh High Court in Jabalpur has directed the state government to grant full pay to 11 forest guards during their probation period in line with its October 31, 2025 order. Bhopal Police To Deploy 56 Specialised Cyber Cops At Stations For Faster Fraud Probes. Bhopal Police will deploy 56 specialised cyber personnel across city police stations to speed up investigations and assist cyber fraud victims. Bhopal To Host 7th MP Travel Mart From Oct 7; Delegates From 34 Countries To Attend. Bhopal will host the 7th Madhya Pradesh Travel Mart from October 7-9 at Kushabhau Thakre Convention Centre, with tourism and industry representatives from 34 countries expected to participate. Unregistered Clinic Sealed In Indore; Officials Find Patients On IV Drips, Large Stock Of Injections. Officials sealed an unregistered clinic in Indore's Chhoti Kumhar Khadi after allegedly finding patients being admitted and administered IV drips, along with a large quantity of injections. ICAR-CIAE, Bhopal and M/s. Natures Bioplastics Pvt. Ltd. Developes Biodegradable films for Milk and water Packaging. As Madhya Pradesh revives public bus network after 21 years, a warning from Gadkari. Praveen Soni withdraws bail plea in cough syrup case. Indore Milk Producers To Demand rupees 12 Per Fat, Release Of rupees 10-12 Crore Pending Bonus At Sept 30 AGM. Milk producers plan to raise three major demands at the Indore Cooperative Milk Producers' Union AGM on September 30, including a purchase rate of rupees 12 per fat. Madhya Pradesh revives public bus transport after 21 years; CM Sugam Parivahan Sewa launched in Bhopal. EaseMyTrip's EMTev rolls out electric buses in Bhopal, targets 5,000 units annually in 5 years. Ganesh Visarjan In MP's Ujjain: UMC Makes Special Arrangements To Protect Kshipra, Water Bodies. Ganesh idols were immersed across Ujjain on Anant Chaturdashi, with UMC arranging designated collection and immersion facilities to protect water bodies. Probe Finds Alleged Corruption in Jal Jeevan Mission Work Done in Madhya Pradesh, Contractor, Government Officials Booked. Four dead, five missing in separate incidents during Ganesh idol immersions in Madhya Pradesh. MP's Ujjain To Host 69th Kalidas Samaroh From Nov 21-27; Focus On Youth, Malwa Culture. The 69th Akhil Bharatiya Kalidas Samaroh will be held in Ujjain from November 21 to 27, with cultural and literary programmes, exhibitions and activities aimed at increasing youth participation. Heavy rain today in 18 districts, including Jabalpur and Rewa: Orange alert in Niwari, Tikamgarh and Chhata. Madhya Pradesh plans rupees 1,300-crore floating solar-battery project to power civic services across 200 cities. Madhya Pradesh CM, Gadkari launch Mukhyamantri Sugam Parivahan Seva, PM e-Bus service; flag off 351 buses.

The revamped app introduces new features such as Home, Code, and Autopilot, enhancing AI capabilities to compete with rivals and focusing on corporate clients for improved AI spending management. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Landlord wanted to start law office, sought tenant's eviction; Delhi HC upheld it for this reason. Tenant ordered to evict as landlord wants to open a law office and proved his bona fide need in Delhi High Court. In this case the landlord's grandfather gave it on rent but his family members needed the property to open a law office as there were three lawyers in their family. Closing an unused credit card? Experts explain how it can affect your credit utilisation. An unused credit card may seem unnecessary, but closing it can reduce your total available credit and increase credit utilisation. Before cancelling a card, borrowers should consider its annual fee, benefits, credit limit, outstanding balances and role in their credit profile. Fruit seller deposited large amount of cash in bank, got income tax notice of unexplained income; won case in ITAT Bangalore for this reason. Bangalore landowner wins unexplained money case in ITAT after proving he sold vegetables and fruit for large amount of cash to APMC Income Tax Act 2025: What crypto investors should know about VDA provisions, TDS and ITR filing rules. The Income-tax Act, 2025 largely retains the existing tax treatment of VDAs, including the 30 percent tax and 1 percent TDS. However, section numbers have changed and a new reporting framework for crypto transactions will require investors to maintain detailed transaction and wallet records. Are all banks open on Sunday, September 27, 2026? Check status ahead of three-day bank strike. Customers can visit public sector banks and Regional Rural Banks on September 27, as they will remain operational ahead of the impending strike from September 28 to 30. The State Bank of India has confirmed that their branches will be accessible this Sunday. It's recommended that customers rely on digital banking during the strike days, as the All India Bank Officers' Association prepares for a stay-out strike during this period. Gold ETF versus Gold FoF: How do they differ and which one costs more?. Gold ETFs trade live on stock exchanges, whereas Gold FoFs are bought and redeemed through mutual fund platforms at end-of-day NAV EPF wage ceiling raised to rupees 25,000: When will higher EPF deductions appear in your salary slip?. Starting September 2026, a major shift in the EPFO wage ceiling will raise the limit from rupees 15,000 to rupees 25,000 monthly. This increase will have different effects on various employees, especially those accustomed to the old ceiling as their deductions will change. Employers could face delays in updating their payroll systems, causing possible arrears and necessary adjustments for workers as they adapt to the new regulations. Diversified equity mutual funds: Which top 5 schemes have outperformed their category over 3 years?. Three-year returns can tell you which diversified equity funds have delivered strong performance, but they don't show the full picture. Here's a look at the funds that topped returns and how their performance stacks up by alpha. Offered lower interest rates on home loans and car loans when you buy insurance? It may not always come cheap; here's how IRDAI proposes to change it. New proposals by IRDAI aim to reform loan-linked insurance offerings from banks and NBFCs, ensuring transparency for borrowers. Key changes may prevent mandatory insurance bundling, allowing for better consumer choices and potential interest rate benefits, while still enabling some insurance package offers. Discover how these reforms could impact your next loan decision. EPFO final PF withdrawal rule: How is your interest calculated up to the payment authorisation date?. EPFO calculates interest on final PF settlements up to the date the final payment is authorised, irrespective of when the claim was submitted. Here's how the interest calculation works and what EPF members should know when making a final withdrawal. Homebuyer pays rupees 1.03 crore for a 3BHK flat with specially enabled parking; builder fails to deliver; Karnataka RERA rules in buyer's favour. Builder promised specially enabled parking spaces; homebuyer paid rupees 1.03 crore for a 3BHK unit, but the builder failed to honour the parking promise; homebuyer wins case in Karnataka RERA. Read the article to know how did the homebuyer win the case. PRIM versus mutual funds versus PMS: Experts explain how they differ on portfolio structure, costs, taxation and suitability. SEBI's new PMS framework introduces PRIM, allowing investors to access professionally managed portfolios of mutual funds, ETFs and SIFs. Here's how PRIM compares with conventional PMS and mutual funds on investment, management, taxation and flexibility. FD interest rate rules to change from October 1, 2026: Uniform interest rates on bulk deposits, daily rate updates and more that depositors need to know. Effective from October 1, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India will implement new rules concerning bulk fixed deposits. Every bank will be mandated to reveal their daily bulk deposit interest rates at 10 am. This regulation aims to ensure that interest rates for identical bulk deposits remain the same in all branches.
